findings.reproduction_evidence: EN promises panic spikes; code instead slows passive panic recovery 70%.
findings.recommended_correction: Align implementation and EN to one contract.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Measure panic behavior for ten minutes above/below stress .7.

findings.reproduction_evidence: Header claims restore, but trait-gated handler only applies once and has no removal path.
findings.recommended_correction: Restore base and clear markers on removal.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Apply, remove, update, assert original value and cleared keys.
